anilist.description:
Now a couple, Amane and Mahiru navigate school life and overcome their pasts in this sweet love story.

(Source: Crunchyroll News)

Note: Crunchyroll has labeled the English title under the name "The Angel Next Door Spoils Me Rotten2", so while it seems erroneous for the title not to have a space between the name and 2, it is what the series is officially labeled as.

schedule.description:
The second season of Otonari no Tenshi-sama ni Itsunomanika Dame Ningen ni Sareteita Ken.

Now a couple, Amane and Mahiru navigate school life and overcome their pasts in this sweet love story.

(Source: Crunchyroll News)

episodes.title: Going to School Together and Making a Debut

titles.ja: 二人での登校とお披露目
titles.en: Going to School Together and Making a Debut
titles.de: Gemeinsam zur Schule gehen und Bekanntmachung
titles.x-jat: Futari de no Toukou to Ohirome

episodes.overview: Now officially dating, Amane and Mahiru surprise their classmates when they go public with their relationship.

episodes.title: The Start of Summer Vacation
episodes.overview: Amane and Mahiru discuss their feelings and then spend a day at the pool, where Mahiru debuts a new swimsuit.

episodes.title: Homecoming, and Revealing the Relationship

titles.de: Heimkehr und Abschluss mit der Vergangenheit
titles.x-jat: Kisei to Kako to no Ketsubetsu

episodes.overview: While visiting Amane's parents, Mahiru learns about Amane's youth and Amane runs into a figure from his past.

episodes.title: A Stay-at-Home Date with the Angel

titles.ja: 天使様とおうちデート
titles.en: A Stay-at-Home Date with the Angel
titles.de: Ein Date zu Hause mit dem Engel

episodes.overview: The family goes shopping and then Amane and Mahiru have a date at home when rain spoils their plans to go out.

episodes.title: A Summer Festival with the Angel

titles.en: A Summer Festival with the Angel

episodes.overview: After returning from their visit to Amane's hometown, Amane takes Mahiru out to see her first summer festival.

episodes.title: A Once-Desired, Now Undesired Meeting, and a Resolution

titles.ja: かつて望んだ望まぬ出会いと, 決意
titles.en: A Once-Desired, Now Undesired Meeting, and a Resolution
titles.de: Eine einst ersehnte, nun unerwünschte Begegnung und ein Entschluss
titles.x-jat: Katsute Nozonda Boumanu Deai to, Ketsui

episodes.overview: Amane and Mahiru discuss their options when a man from Mahiru's past unexpectedly shows up at their building.

episodes.title: The Angel`s Pleas
episodes.overview: Mahiru and Amane talk about next steps as they get ready for the culture festival and their class's maid café.

episodes.title: Culture Festival, Day One
episodes.overview: Mahiru and Amane get a lot of attention dressed up for their maid and butler cafe during the school festival.

episodes.title: The Angel`s Request
episodes.overview: Amane's parents visit the school festival and Itsuki explains why his father is unwilling to accept Chitose.

episodes.title: An Important Promise with the Angel

titles.en: An Important Promise with the Angel
titles.de: Ein wichtiges Versprechen dem Engel gegenüber

episodes.overview: Amane worries about taking proper responsibility before he and Mahiru embark on a more intimate relationship.

episodes.title: First Part-Time Job
episodes.overview: Amane goes behind Itsuki's back and starts a part-time job in order to save up for a special gift for Mahiru.

episodes.title: The Angel`s Big Day Arrives

titles.ja: そうして迎えた天使様のXデー
titles.de: Der große Tag des Engels steht an
titles.x-jat: Soshite Mukaeta Tenshi-sama no X Day

episodes.overview: Mahiru prepares a special meal for Amane on a special day, and the two clarify their feelings for each other.
